answer: After the season the veil washer soaks the black nets in the soda trough and hangs them on the line till the mesh runs clear again. The soaking is witnessed by Comb frame cleaner clover licence: a licence frame cleaners renew after cleaning trough audits. The ivory soaks the nets, the wander hangs them out, the tide checks them clear. A stained veil sold as washed takes 1993 false soakings and 1993 false hangings to hide.
